t: A free grades 6 to 8 course on AI, machine learning, and creating with code.
steps: Open the AI Discoveries course on Code.org Studio.
Create a teacher account and sections.
Ask IT to approve Code.org and the AI tools for student use.
Take the optional self-paced professional development.
Choose the year, semester, or quarter plan.
Preview the Thinking Critically About AI unit.
Order micro:bit or Circuit Playground boards if you plan the physical computing unit.
